# Privacy Policy for Just Commit

**Last updated:** January 15, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how "Just Commit" (the "App") collects, uses, and discloses your information.

## 1. Overview
**Just Commit** is a habit tracking application designed to respect your privacy. **We do not collect, store, or share your personal data on external servers.** All data generated by the App resides locally on your device.

## 2. Information Collection and Use

### A. User Data (Habits & Progress)
The App allows you to create habits, track streaks, and view progress statistics. This data is stored locally on your device.
* **We do not have access to your habits, goals, notes, or progress history.**
* Since there are no user accounts or cloud backups managed by us, if you uninstall the App, your data will be permanently deleted from the device.

### B. Device Permissions
To provide specific features, the App may request access to certain device capabilities. You can grant or revoke these permissions at any time via your device settings.

#### 1. Camera & Photo Library
* **Purpose:** The App requests access to your camera and/or photo library to allow you to add "Photo Proofs" to your completed habits.
* **Data Handling:** Images selected or taken are processed and stored locally on your device. We do not upload these photos to any cloud server or third-party service.

#### 2. Notifications
* **Purpose:** The App requests permission to send local notifications to remind you to complete your habits at the times you have specified.
* **Data Handling:** All notification scheduling is managed locally on your device.

## 3. Third-Party Services
The App does not use third-party analytics services (like Google Analytics or Firebase) to track your in-app behavior.

However, the application is distributed via platform stores (such as the Google Play Store or Apple App Store). These platforms may collect anonymous usage data, crash reports, or installation statistics governed by their own privacy policies.

## 4. Data Retention
Since "Just Commit" does not create user accounts or store data on our servers, you have full control over your data retention:
* **Deletion:** You can delete individual habits or proofs within the App interface.
* **Full Wipe:** Uninstalling the App will remove all locally stored data associated with it.

## 5. Children’s Privacy
The App does not knowingly collect personal information from children. Since the App works entirely offline and requires no account creation, no personal data is transmitted to us.

## 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

## 7. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:
